summary: This is a routine 8-K filed by Genprex, Inc. (a pharmaceutical company) regarding a press release announcing positive preclinical data on its diabetes gene therapy candidate to be presented at an upcoming conference. The filing contains no transactional event such as an acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, restructuring, or any other special situation. As a routine current report on research developments, it does not fall under any special-situations category.
